verdict.rationale: Puzzle markets a free migration from QuickBooks that claims no data is lost. It also documents CSV bulk import for manual journal entries and the chart of accounts, which could carry historical books from other systems. Beyond those marketing taglines and the CSV templates, nothing documents how transaction-level detail is preserved, and only QuickBooks is named as a source. Missing for 10: documented migration process and scope, evidence that transaction-level detail (attachments, classes, customers/vendors) carries over, support for sources other than QuickBooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
